vote.question: Community Accountability Resolution [US-OH U.S. Senate]: Jon Husted (R) has received $19,894,786 in career campaign contributions (anchored this cycle by MAGA Inc. ($200,000,000) and $636,907,000 from top-5 patrons)—linked to "Private Equity, Speculative Finance & Real Estate Syndicate". Should OH release the community fund to local charities working on affordable housing trusts, predatory-lending legal aid, and household debt relief?
vote.futarchy_thesis: Large campaign contributions create public concern over policy priorities. When Jon Husted receives $19,894,786 (anchored this cycle by MAGA Inc. ($200,000,000) and $636,907,000 from top-5 patrons), community members want accountability. This fund lets residents decide whether to direct community resources to local public causes.

question_vars.capture_archetype: Private Equity, Speculative Finance & Real Estate Syndicate

options: Yes — Send Fund to Local Charities
No — Send Fund to Essential Community Services

outcomes.YES_RELEASE_TO_LOCAL_CHARITIES: Directs 100% of the funds to verified local non-profits working directly on state community needs.
outcomes.NO_RELEASE_TO_COMMUNITY_COMMONS: Directs 100% of the funds to bipartisan, universal local public services (volunteer fire/EMS, veterans' care, food banks, disaster relief).
outcomes.ABSTAIN_LOG_DISSENT: Records resident feedback without moving the vote count.

futarchy_pole_mechanics.leverage_ratio_statement: Every contribution directly empowers community-led funding. Once the campaign pool reaches $10,000, an automatic 60-day countdown begins. When the 60 days expire, all funds go directly to verified local charities or essential community services—zero platform cut.

bounty_if_passed.description: Community Fund for US-OH: Delivers 100% of funds to verified, IRS-registered 501(c)(3) public charities serving OH dedicated to affordable housing trusts, predatory-lending legal aid, and household debt relief. Verified local recipients: CHN HOUSING PARTNERS (US-EIN:341346763); OHIO CAPITAL CORPORATION FOR HOUSING (US-EIN:311265570); COLUMBUS HOUSING PARTNERSHIP INC (US-EIN:311208260); LEGAL AID OF SOUTHEAST AND CENTRAL OHIO (US-EIN:310718185); THE AFFORDABLE HOUSING TRUST FOR COLUMBUS & FRANKLIN COUNTY (US-EIN:311727952). Once the pool hits $10,000, a 60-day timer starts. If YES wins, funds go to these charities; if NO wins, funds go to local community commons (fire/EMS, veterans, food banks).
bounty_if_passed.destination_criteria: All recipient organizations must be active, verified 501(c)(3) public charities registered in US-OH with clean IRS status and direct community impact. Approved charities: CHN HOUSING PARTNERS (US-EIN:341346763); OHIO CAPITAL CORPORATION FOR HOUSING (US-EIN:311265570); COLUMBUS HOUSING PARTNERSHIP INC (US-EIN:311208260); LEGAL AID OF SOUTHEAST AND CENTRAL OHIO (US-EIN:310718185); THE AFFORDABLE HOUSING TRUST FOR COLUMBUS & FRANKLIN COUNTY (US-EIN:311727952).

trigger_conditions: Condition 1 (Activation): The campaign activates its 60-day countdown timer as soon as total contributions reach $10,000 USD (Base USDC).
Condition 2 (Resolution Period): The community vote runs for exactly 60 days from the moment the $10,000 threshold is reached.

Condition 3 (Payout): If YES receives 60% or more of votes, 100% of the funds are sent to the verified state non-profits; otherwise, 100% is sent to universal community services (fire/EMS, veterans, food banks).

bounty_if_no_wins.destination_criteria: MUST be an IRS-audited 501(c)(3) public charity in US-OH operating in non-ideological universal commons (NTEE M24 Fire & Rescue, M20 Disaster Relief, W30 Veterans, K31 Food Banks, E20/E22 Community Hospitals, O Youth Development) with zero partisan lobbying, chosen only where both sides of the political divide benefit. Eligible commons beneficiaries: COMMUNITY CARE AMBULANCE NETWORK (US-EIN:341766905); MID-OHIO FOODBANK (US-EIN:310865343); BON SECOURS MERCY HEALTH INC (US-EIN:521301088); UNIVERSITY HOSPITALS HEALTH SYSTEM INC (US-EIN:900059117); OHIOHEALTH CORPORATION (US-EIN:314394942).
